findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_flight_status · Private data: get_flight_status, get_flight_history, search_flights, get_airline_stats, list_flight_disruptions, get_flight_track, get_aircraft_position, get_airport_status, list_disrupted_airports, get_airport_departures, get_airport_arrivals, list_airport_movements · Public sink: get_flight_status, get_airline_stats, get_flight_position, get_flight_track, get_aircraft_position, get_aircraft_track, list_aircraft_in_area, get_observed_flights, get_airport_status, list_disrupted_airports, list_chokepoints, get_chokepoint_status · Destructive: get_train_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_flight_status · Private data: get_flight_status, get_flight_history, search_flights, get_airline_stats, list_flight_disruptions, get_flight_track, get_aircraft_position, get_airport_status, list_disrupted_airports, get_airport_departures, get_airport_arrivals, list_airport_movements · Public sink: get_flight_status, get_airline_stats, get_flight_position, get_flight_track, get_aircraft_position, get_aircraft_track, list_aircraft_in_area, get_observed_flights, get_airport_status, list_disrupted_airports, list_chokepoints, get_chokepoint_status · Destructive: get_train_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
